🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No AUKUS intelligence sharing without explicit UK national interest justification.
  • ❌ No transfer of sensitive UK AI/autonomy IP without a signed FCDO/MOD/DSIT inter-government agreement.
  • ❌ No deployment of AUKUS joint capabilities that violate international humanitarian law or human rights conventions.
  • ❌ No permanent hosting of UK classified intelligence data on non-UK sovereign cloud infrastructure without specific FCDO/MOD approval.
  • ❌ No participation in AUKUS cyber operations that could compromise UK critical national infrastructure.
  • ❌ No AUKUS intelligence sharing with third parties without express UK government consent.
